card.name: Receiving or combined with hormone therapies
card.fires_on: The word "receive", "receiving" or "with" (after "in combination") just before a named hormone-type drug, mostly in prostate cancer and hormone therapy labels.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says patients receive, or are combined with, another hormone-type drug.
